description: Make official Modal Argon 8 firmware boot on a Cobalt 8 (model id 0x19) unit.

provenance.source_images: Official Modal Electronics firmware files, supplied by the user. Not included in this repository and not obtainable through it.
provenance.confirmed: NOT YET CONFIRMED ON HARDWARE. Gate located by static analysis (same method as carbon8_1-1_to_cobalt8); flash at your own risk.

edits.what: cmp r3,#0xff -> cmp r3,#0x19 (model gate operand low 7 bits)
cmp r3,#0xff -> cmp r3,#0x19 (clear bit 2 in MSB bundle byte so operand is 0x19, not 0x99)

notes: Only the packet model byte is changed on master/slave; their payloads are untouched (no model self-check strings found in either image).
The single meaningful engineering change is one instruction (the model gate compare immediate) in the panel image: 0xff -> 0x19.
Unlike Carbon 1-1 (cmp r3,#0x1d) and Cobalt 2-1 (cmp r3,#0x19), the Argon 3-2 gate compares against 0xff; the patch is otherwise identical in structure.
Argon 8 firmware revision 3-2 only; other revisions have a different layout and are deliberately refused by the SHA-256 gate.
